missions.title: Rich Vein
missions.briefing: Okafor: the survey turned up a rich {vein.res} seam at {vein}. Stake it and haul some of it home.

objectives.text: Put a Mining Complex or the crawler on the seam

missions.debrief: The seam's paying out. Nice find.

missions.title: Storm Watch
missions.briefing: Reyes: a storm front is coming in over the base. I'd love real readings from inside it: park a rover in the open while it blows through.

objectives.text: Keep a rover parked in the open during the storm
objectives.hint: Out of cover, standing still, in the storm itself. Rough on the rover.

missions.debrief: Sixty seconds of storm telemetry from the ground. Worth every scratch.

missions.title: Lost Signal
missions.briefing: Reyes: orbit picked up regular shapes under the ground in the marked area. Artificial, maybe. A drone pass over it would tell us.

objectives.text: Fly a drone over the marked area

missions.debrief: Ruins. Old ones, and not built by anyone we know. They're on the map now.

missions.title: Sky Survey
missions.briefing: Reyes: the survey satellites are doing well. Keep them sweeping until they've mapped half of this world.

objectives.text: Satellites survey half of the map

missions.debrief: Half a world mapped from orbit. The cartographers at home owe you a drink.

missions.title: Rescue
missions.briefing: Okafor: {victim} is disabled out there, far from any pad. Crew's fine, reserve power isn't. Get another vehicle or a drone to them inside five minutes.

objectives.text: Reach {victim} with another vehicle or a drone

missions.debrief: Help reached {victim} in time. Nobody gets left out there.
